commands.title: Choose the repository
commands.intent: Open a repository without changing shell directories.
commands.starting_state: A jj repository with a working copy and visible history.
commands.result: All native views use the selected repository.
commands.verification: Check the view title, selected object and rendered output; use Command History (C) for the exact command.
commands.cancel: Quit jk and restart with different startup arguments; a startup argument is not an in-app draft.
commands.failure: Argument or initial-load failures may occur before the UI or Command History exists; read stderr in the launching terminal.
commands.recovery: Correct the startup argument, path or repository configuration and restart jk.
limitations: The repository flag is a top-level jk option; supply it before a subcommand.

commands.title: Open a local repository container
commands.intent: Find a child workspace when the repository root has no working copy.
commands.starting_state: A local jj outer container with no working-copy commit and at least one registered child workspace under its repository root.
commands.result: The resolver intends to select the default child, otherwise the lexicographically first child. With tested jj 0.45.1, its exact diagnostic check misses No working copy. (with a period), so automatic selection fails and startup lacks the intended working-copy context.
commands.verification: Observe the no-working-copy result from bare jk, then quit and run jk -R default; status must show the child working copy and workspace inspection must list it.
commands.cancel: Quit jk and restart with different startup arguments; a startup argument is not an in-app draft.
commands.failure: Argument or initial-load failures may occur before the UI or Command History exists; read stderr in the launching terminal.
commands.recovery: From the container, run jk -R default or change into the intended child workspace before launching.
limitations: Known defect UX-18: automatic child selection fails with the No working copy. diagnostic emitted by tested jj 0.45.1. Use an explicit repository path.
A sibling workspace outside the container is not selected automatically.

commands.title: Navigate diff text and parsed files
entry_points: [ / ] files; { / } hunks; f file list; h / l file folds; - / + hunk folds; / n N search
commands.intent: Find text and recognized file sections in a rendered diff.
commands.starting_state: A jj repository with a working copy and visible history.
commands.result: Text search and scrolling work. Color-words regular-file sections support file navigation and file folding. Normal Git and color-words output do not produce recognized hunk sections, so hunk movement and folding are ineffective.
commands.verification: Check that f lists the color-words file paths and that a folded file hides its body. Search must reach the matching text. Do not treat pressing hunk keys as proof that a hunk was recognized.
commands.cancel: Backspace returns to the preceding view. Escape quits jk from this content view; use Escape only to dismiss an open overlay when one is active.
commands.failure: Read the error and Command History before retrying; jj owns repository validation.
commands.recovery: Return to the previous view, correct the operand or configuration, and refresh.
limitations: Known defect UX-17: Git-format headers are not parsed into file sections, so file-list navigation and file folding are unavailable in that format.
Known defect UX-17: color-words file sections lack @@ headers, while Git @@ headers lack recognized file sections; native hunk movement and folding do not work on ordinary output.
